comment: Canonical improvement-dimension vocabulary (SSOT). Prose lives in docs/concepts/DIMENSIONS.md. Test Genie finding source tokens and skill target_dimensions declarations map into this vocabulary; descriptor-owned Test Genie phase dimensions live in scenarios/*/.vrooli/test-genie.json. Edit here only for global dimension/source vocabulary.

dimensions.description: Coding-standards, lint, and type-safety violations.
Package/file placement, domain-authority confidence, placement coverage, and screaming-architecture (where code lives).
Import cycles and cross-domain coupling findings from architecture-cartographer.
CLI/API manifest and binding contract gaps (cli-health).
UI manifest and slot-binding health (ui-health).
Rendered UI behavior — playbook regressions. UI render/handshake checks fold into the `ui` dimension via ui-health's execution-mode runtime group.
Accessibility (a11y) conformance. No test-genie producer in v0; skill-supplied.
Documentation coverage and reference integrity (knowledge-observatory).

Automated test presence, execution, architecture, and quality. Produced by the test-genie `unit` phase, which delegates to the unit-health scenario (the separate `integration` phase was retired in the unit-health hard cutover).

Test-coverage levels. Produced by the test-genie `unit` phase, which delegates coverage analysis to the unit-health scenario (the separate `coverage` phase was retired in the unit-health hard cutover).
Vulnerabilities, leaked secrets, and SAST findings. Produced by the test-genie `security` phase, which delegates to the security-health scenario.
Bundle size, latency, and web-vitals regressions.
PRD / operational-target completion (progress). Measured via gap metrics, not findings.
Dependency hygiene and governance.
Business-logic validation.
File and function quality nits (tidiness-manager).
Declared scenario dependencies match actual import-level interface usage. Produced by the test-genie `dependencies` phase, which delegates to scenario-dependency-analyzer drift.

Measure coverage of stateful domains: each persisted-entity domain declares a named, typed, parameterized analytical query (or is waived). Produced by the test-genie `measures` phase, which delegates to the measures-health scenario.

Protocol Buffer contract organization, generated-artifact sync, transport-world clarity, and scenario-scoped proto-surface facts. Produced by the test-genie `proto` phase, which delegates to proto-health.

Storage judgment: schema layout, migration hygiene, persistence-seam adoption, and test-isolation safety. Produced by the test-genie `storage` phase, which delegates to the storage-manager scenario; its L2 isolation verdict is a fail-closed precondition for the destructive `playbooks` phase.

Brand-identity completeness, accessibility, and installability — display name, color system, typography, logo, favicon, WCAG-AA contrast (light + dark), applied brand markers, cross-surface name/theme consistency, template-residue, PWA/manifest + mobile status-bar safe-area theming, social/link-preview metadata, and CLI/API branding (brand-manager via the test-genie `branding` phase).
